This app provides real-time GPS coordinates to your máy ảnh via Bluetooth, allowing for automatic gắn thẻ địa lý of your ảnh without needing a camera's built-in GPS.
Check the app nhật ký in the top menu for troubleshooting information, or review your thiết bị Cài đặt to ensure tất cả permissions are granted.
How do I connect my máy ảnh to the app?

1. Make sure your máy ảnh supports Bluetooth connectivity and GPS tagging 2. Bật Bluetooth on your máy ảnh and phone 3. Put your máy ảnh in ghép nối mode, click on the máy ảnh on the main screen and follow the on-screen instructions (both máy ảnh and phone) 4. If this fails, Xóa any ghép nối in the Bluetooth Cài đặt of the phone and máy ảnh. Then try again
Why isn't my máy ảnh appearing in the list?

• Ensure your máy ảnh is in pairing/Bluetooth mode • Check that your máy ảnh supports the bắt buộc Bluetooth Hồ sơ • Make sure you\\'re within range (typically 10 meters) • Try restarting Bluetooth on your phone
My máy ảnh is losing kết nối tất cả the thời gian

Try these solutions: • Keep your phone closer to the máy ảnh • Tắt battery optimization for the app • Check whether your máy ảnh has power-saving modes that affect Bluetooth • Khởi động lại both devices and ghép nối them again if needed
How do I Bật the dịch vụ permanently? It seems to stop after a while

Please visit the App Cài đặt and try the options in the Battery & Nền section. Alternatively try the following: To keep GPS data syncing with your máy ảnh: 1. Go to your device\\'s Cài đặt > Apps 2. Tìm \\'Alpha GPS\\' in the app list 3. Tap on it and select \\'Battery\\' 4. Choose \\'Don\\'t optimize\\' or \\'Allow nền activity\\' 5. This prevents the system from stopping the GPS dịch vụ You can also access this through the thiết bị details page in the app.
My máy ảnh does not connect automatically, what can I do?

Unfortunately, there might be situations, where the automatic kết nối does not work. If you encounter issues please do the following: On the main screen, tap on your máy ảnh to Mở the details screen. There you have an option to Bật the Always On mode, which will keep the app in the foreground. Otherwise try toggling Bluetooth or Xóa the thiết bị from the app and ghép nối it again.
What permissions does the app need?

The app requires: • Location permissions (for GPS data) • Bluetooth permissions (to connect to camera) • Battery optimization exemption (for continuous service) • Nearby devices permission (for thiết bị discovery)
How accurate is the GPS data?
GPS accuracy depends on: • Satellite visibility (better outdoors) • Weather conditions • Your phone's GPS capabilities • Typical accuracy is 3–5 meters under good conditions
Does the app work in the nền?

Có, once properly configured: • The dịch vụ runs in the nền to maintain GPS sync • Make sure to Tắt battery optimization • The app will Hiện a persistent thông báo when đang hoạt động • GPS data is continuously sent to your connected máy ảnh

Bật location & thời gian zone linking (older cameras)
On máy ảnh with the older menu layout (e.g. α6400, ZV-E10, α6100, α7 III) location linking must be switched on manually. Newer máy ảnh activate it automatically when the app connects.
On the máy ảnh, turn on location linking:
Menu → Network → Loc. Thông tin. Liên kết Set. → Location Thông tin. Liên kết → On
To also take over thời gian and thời gian zone from the phone, Bật both options in the same menu:
Auto Thời gian Correct. → On • Auto Area Adjust. → On
If the menu items are grayed out or linking still fails, turn off the Bluetooth remote — see section 3.
Sony Trợ giúp Guide: Loc. Thông tin. Liên kết Set. (α6400)
Sony Trợ giúp Guide: Location Thông tin. Liên kết Set. (ZV-E10)
Máy ảnh connects but GPS doesn't work

Typical when the máy ảnh was set up with Sony's Creators' App or Imaging Edge Mobile before: the phone is already paired with the máy ảnh, so Không Mới ghép nối is requested — but location transfer doesn't work properly with Alpha GPS. Removing the Cũ ghép nối everywhere fixes this.
Xóa the camera from your phone's Bluetooth settings:
Cài đặt → Connected devices (Bluetooth) → your máy ảnh → Forget
Cài đặt → Bluetooth → ⓘ Tiếp to the máy ảnh → Forget This Thiết bị
On the máy ảnh, Xóa the Cũ ghép nối (older models don't have this menu item — there, ghép nối again simply replaces the Cũ connection):
Menu → Network → Bluetooth → Manage Paired Thiết bị
If a Sony app is still installed, Xóa the máy ảnh there as well:
Creators' App → Máy ảnh → Setup → Unpair
Set up the máy ảnh again in Alpha GPS: put it into ghép nối mode and start a Mới scan.
Turn off the Bluetooth remote (older cameras)

Máy ảnh like the α6400 cannot use the Bluetooth remote and location linking at the same thời gian — with the remote on, the kết nối or GPS transfer stops working. Newer models (e.g. α7 IV and later) support both.
On the máy ảnh, switch the Bluetooth remote off:
Menu → Network → Bluetooth Rmt Ctrl → Off
In Alpha GPS, tap the máy ảnh on the main screen and turn off Bậte remote control'.
Sony Trợ giúp Guide: Bluetooth Rmt Ctrl (α6400)
If ảnh are tagged with a position that is noticeably off, the app usually isn't allowed to use your precise location.
Allow precise location for Alpha GPS:
Cài đặt → Apps → Alpha GPS → Permissions → Location → Use precise location
Cài đặt → Privacy & Security → Location Services → Alpha GPS → Precise Location → On
Exclude the app from battery optimization so transmission keeps running in the nền: Cài đặt → Apps → Alpha GPS → Battery → Unrestricted.
The máy ảnh '%1$s' refused the ghép nối.
This often happens when the máy ảnh is not in ghép nối mode or is still paired with another thiết bị:
• Put the máy ảnh into ghép nối mode: Menu → Network → Bluetooth → Ghép nối.
• On the máy ảnh, Xóa Cũ pairings: Menu → Network → Bluetooth → Manage Paired Thiết bị.
• Xóa the máy ảnh from your phone's Bluetooth Cài đặt (Settings → Bluetooth), then try again.

Máy ảnh not found? Make sure it is in ghép nối mode. If it was set up with Sony's Creators' App or Imaging Edge Mobile before, Xóa the Cũ ghép nối from the máy ảnh and from your phone's Bluetooth Cài đặt — the troubleshooting guide walks you through it.
On some máy ảnh models, remote control cannot be used while location linking is đang hoạt động. If the kết nối or GPS transfer stops working, turn this off.

On the Tiếp screen, follow the instructions to ghép nối your máy ảnh. Once ghép nối is complete, the app will automatically connect to your máy ảnh and start transmitting location data. If it does not start immediately, try restarting your máy ảnh.

If the mặc định kết nối mode does not work, you can Bật Always On mode after ghép nối your thiết bị. Tap the thiết bị entry on the main screen and turn on the toggle. This mode may use more battery, but only transmits location data when connected to the máy ảnh.
